title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - First Action - Abusive Client Behavior
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: During a virtual mediation, a paralegal's client becomes enraged and starts hurling aggressive, racist slurs at the opposing party. What is the paralegal's **first action**?
options: Mute their microphone, laugh it off, and allow the client to vent to gain leverage.
Immediately intervene, advise the client to stop the abusive behavior, and state clearly that the paralegal will not participate in or allow the proceeding to be abusive.
Secretly record the interaction to protect the paralegal's own liability.
Agree with the client to maintain solidarity and a strong paralegal-client relationship.
questions.explain: Rule 2.01 (Duty of Civility/Human Rights). A paralegal must treat all persons with courtesy and respect and must not participate in, or allow, a proceeding to be abusive or harassing. The paralegal has a positive duty to intervene, advise their client to stop the discrimination/abuse, and potentially withdraw if the client refuses to act civilly.
